name: IRLB8721
source: International Rectifier IRLB8721PbF データシート (PD-97390, 2009-04)
description: N チャネル パワーMOSFET 30V 62A (TO-220, ピン1=G 2=D 3=S)。ロジックレベル駆動 (4.5V でオン)。データシート (IR) の代表特性から作った等価モデル (レベル1 + 直列抵抗、ボディダイオードつき)

transfer.at: Fig 3 (伝達特性の代表特性、VDS = 15 V) の 25 °C (PDF の曲線の線から読んだ)

body_diode.at: Fig 7 (ソース・ドレイン間ダイオードの順方向の代表特性) の 25 °C (PDF の曲線の線から読んだ)

remarks: the table: VGS(th) 1.35 / 1.80 / 2.35 V (25 uA), RDS(on) typ 6.5 / 13.1 mohm (10 V 31 A, 4.5 V 25 A), max 8.7 / 16; Ciss 1077, Coss 360, Crss 110 pF (VGS = 0, VDS = 15 V, 1 MHz); gfs 35 S min (15 V, 25 A); VSD max 1.0 V at 25 A
transfer: Fig 3 (VDS = 15 V), the 25 C curve (the right one at small currents), read from its vector line

left out Fig 3's points above 120 A (6 V: 145 A, 7 V: 187 A; twice the continuous rating): level 1 cannot follow them and the on resistance together, and with them RDS(on) at 4.5 V came out 31 % high instead of 21 %
body_diode: Fig 7, the 25 C curve (the right one), 0.1 to 100 A
i_max is the TC = 25 C rating (62 A) with a heat sink; without one the part is held by theta_ja 62 C/W
